title: MCP server transport hardening

patterns.message: MCP/HTTP server binding to 0.0.0.0 — bind to 127.0.0.1 for local servers and validate the Origin header.

remediation: Bind local MCP servers to 127.0.0.1, validate the Origin header (DNS-rebinding), require TLS + OAuth 2.1 for remote; never forward client tokens downstream.
